name: Secret Visitor
background: Seen entering the house of Lazarus under cover of darkness before the feast.

genericReactions.physical: I cannot say what this is or where it came from.
genericReactions.testimonial: I was not there. I saw nothing.
genericReactions.digital: I have no knowledge of these matters.
genericReactions.environmental: I move in the shadows. The location is not important.
genericReactions.analytical: You are asking the wrong questions.
genericReactions.prophecy: Some things are best left unsaid.
